description: Ghani Glass Limited is a glass manufacturer incorporated in Pakistan in 1992 and part of the House of Ghani. It manufactures and sells float glass and glass containers, supplying the pharmaceutical, food and beverage, construction and industrial packaging sectors in domestic and export markets. The company reports seven manufacturing facilities in Pakistan, more than 5,000 customers and an export presence in over 26 countries.
headOffice: Ghani Complex, 40-L Model Town Extension, Lahore, Pakistan
